label: Raspberry Pi Compute Module 4
description: SO-DIMM-format BCM2711 module whose gigabit MAC/PHY and optional dual-band 802.11ac radio are only usable through a carrier board that exposes the RJ45 and antenna connectors.
notes: No connectors on the module itself: eth0 assumes a carrier board with an RJ45 (most do), wlan0 assumes a wireless SKU (CM4 has 'Lite' and non-wireless variants). Nice for modelling custom multi-NIC carrier boards.
